caption: The drawing depicts a vertically-oriented, rectangular object that resembles a fabric or felt pouch. The body of the pouch is light brown and consists of several vertical stitched compartments, each containing a metal object resembling a knitting needle or similar tool, with only the tops of the tools visible. The upper section of the pouch has a flap that covers the compartments; this flap is a reddish-orange color and features the stitched text "MR" followed by an additional, partially legible mark that may be "M. R. 53." The background of the drawing is a plain off-white color, and no additional objects or patterns are present in the composition.
title: Shaker Case for Knitting Needles
